note: Two columns joined on each line, separated by reading order. Page is the Special Needs Department continued (no one building), page school district-wide; the left column runs: Tapply, Thibeault, Wilson (staff), P.L. 94-142 Title VI-B TEACHERS (14: Davenport, Hens, Hoffman-Scoggins, Leahy), AIDE/TUTOR (33: Bambarola, Tulonen), SPECIAL NEEDS CLERICAL (44), SPEECH THERAPISTS (54); right column: SPECIAL NEEDS AIDES (line 1: Aho .. Lindquist) and SPECIAL NEEDS TUTORS (37: Gedenberg, Green, Johnston, Kondig) plus the aide Shepard etc. Heading line 1 holds both column headings; line 14 holds a left heading and a right role continuation; 33 and 37 and 44 likewise share lines with other text. School per entry from printed parentheticals or grade span: (Elementary School) / Grades 2-5 -> passios (bare 'Elementary School' = Passios, inference from other pages); (Primary School) -> primary; (Middle School) / Grades 6-8 / 'Office: Middle School' -> middle; High School / Grades 9-12 -> high; K-12 / K-5 / '(Elementary & High Schools)' -> district-wide. Roles span several lines; those lines are ignored. Line 61 page number. Resignation notes are inline remarks on current entries (not a separate list). Honorifics kept as printed. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
